title: Fishpaws hearts
description: This resource pack adds new heart textures, all with the face of Fishpaws_ on them!
body:
This resource pack adds new heart models to minecraft! All new hearts contain the face of Fishpaws_! This resource pack currently contains 16 different heart models:
1. Full
2. Half
3. Empty
4. Full blinking
5. Half blinking
6. Empty blinking
7. Hardcore full
8. Hardcore half
9. Hardcore empty
10. Hardcore full blinking
11. Hardcore half blinking
12. Hardcore empty blinking
13. Absorbing full
14. Absorbing half
15. Absorbing empty
16. Absorbing full blinking
17. Absorbing half blinking
